claims: The Artemis II mission is designed to last approximately 10 days.
The Artemis II mission launches on April 1, 2026.
The Artemis II mission has a four-person crew.
The Artemis II mission crew will journey around the Moon and return to Earth.
The Artemis II mission crew will test the Orion spacecraft's systems before splashdown in the Pacific Ocean.
The Artemis II mission type is crewed lunar flyby.
The Artemis II mission has no lunar landing.
The Artemis II mission length is ~10 days (approx. 240 hours).
The Artemis II mission crew will test systems in high Earth orbit.
The Artemis II mission crew will journey toward the Moon.
The Artemis II mission crew will fly by the lunar far side around day 5-6.
The Artemis II mission is expected to take the crew farther from Earth than any previous human mission.
The Artemis II mission is the first crewed flight of the SLS rocket.
The Artemis II mission is the first crewed flight of the Orion spacecraft.
The Artemis II mission serves as a critical precursor to the Artemis III landing mission.
